imageGeneration.prompt: Faithfully refine and upscale this real published Perfekt Auto dealership logo as a clean transparent raster, retaining its recognizable red handwritten/cursive script, the exact Latin spelling Perfekt Auto, and the thin red car roof-line above the words. Smooth sharp contours, same deep red ink on white/light surfaces. Remove the white rectangular backdrop entirely including all spaces around/between letters. Real RGBA transparent background with clean open letter counters. One complete compact wide logo centered with modest padding. Render lettering clearly at small website-header scale without changing the identity.
